claims.text: Semantic density extracts uncertainty/confidence information for each response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.
Semantic density has no restriction on task types.
Semantic density is 'off-the-shelf' for new models and tasks.
Semantic density demonstrates superior performance and robustness compared to prior approaches on free-form question-answering benchmarks.

evidence.description: Experiments on seven state-of-the-art LLMs, including Llama 3 and Mixtral-8x22B, on four free-form question-answering benchmarks.

methodologies.name: Semantic Density
methodologies.description: A framework that extracts uncertainty/confidence information for each response from a probability distribution perspective in semantic space.

limitations.text: Existing LLMs do not have an inherent functionality to provide the users with an uncertainty/confidence metric for each response it generates.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods are restricted to classification tasks.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods require additional training and data.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods consider only lexical instead of semantic information.
Prior uncertainty quantification methods are prompt-wise but not response-wise.
